 HoopsHype Nov. 17, 2026, 9:04 p.m. ET Omari Sankofa II: JB on Duncan Robinson and Ron Holland’s injuries: “Obviously we’ll take our time with both of them and make sure they come back right, and again, it’s next man up for us.” Also talks Chaz Lanier, handling Wemby without Jalen Duren, and what Tobias Harris meant to the team.
